5. The Mystery of the Mansion
When Jane received that text message from "D," the investigation had officially begun.
From the moment we set out onto the streets, Jane has been speaking in an unbroken current.
Jane
...So, this is the perfect opportunity to give you a detailed understanding of the ABC theft case.

Convinced that the next target had to be an item associated with the letter D, the police department deployed officers all over the city to intercept and apprehend the thief... It was an incredible show of force.
However! That sort of thinking only played right into the perpetrator's hands.
But it was never about the letters – that was just a smokescreen to distract the police from the criminal's true motive: the item they actually wanted to steal.
By analyzing the underlying connections between the items, I was able to deduce the thief's true intentions...
Hohoho... Their real goal had nothing to do with letters! And thanks to my gift of predicting suspects' next moves, we successfully apprehended the thief!
I see...
And that's why determining the motive for a crime is so important in detective work!
So, our job today is to gather clues pertaining to the motive of the crime... in a location on the outskirts of One Han City.
You know, I'm curious...
Huh? About what?
You said we're going to gather clues...
But how did you infer the target location?
Hohoho... Good, very good! Maintaining a healthy skepticism is key to being a great assistant! You're starting to get the hang of this!
As for how I inferred the location... Obviously, I...
You...?
I used my contacts in the city's police department to trace the suspect's IP address and lock onto the location where the message was sent!
Our perp may be long gone by now, but they're bound to have left clues anywhere they lingered for long enough. So, the first place to check is their last known location.
Oh... that's it?
Don't look so crestfallen, my dear assistant! Detective work isn't always as exciting as in comics and novels.
In this era of advanced technology, you have to leverage all your resources if you want to fast-track to the truth.
After all, the important thing is to rely on your own abilities to protect justice. Focusing too much on the methodology is counterproductive.
I guess that makes sense...
Got it! I'll assist however I can!
Okay. Whatever awaits us there, we have to search for any clues "D" left behind and use them to infer the motive.
Oh, that reminds me... You're not easily scared, are you?
What do you mean...?
Well, the location we'll be hitting today is the abandoned mansion at the edge of One Han City – the one everyone's saying is haunted.
Rumor has it that every person to occupy it since it was built has died under mysterious circumstances.
Even the most recent occupant vanished with no explanation... The mansion has been a hotbed of paranormal activity ever since.
Wait, hold on...!
Why are you only telling me this now?!
Hohoho! You're not scared, are you? Relax!
I'm a skeptic through and through. Show me the evidence that proves the existence of the paranormal!
I intend to expose all that trickery with rigorous logic... Ah, looks like we're here.
...Is it too late to turn back?
Maybe we should come back another time when we're better prepared!
Hellooo? Anyone home? Coming in now, excuse us!
W-wait for me!
It's so dark...
Hmm... The air is more humid in here, and it's at least three degrees colder than outside.
Looks like the place hasn't been maintained in quite some time. That's hardly a surprise, though. The ghost stories scare most people off.
Good thing, too – with nobody here, we can carry out our investigation in peace. Hey, pass me a flashlight.
On it.
Hmm... Nice decor, but the place is far more run-down than I was expecting...
The power's out, and the steps to the second floor are badly rotted. Be careful when we go up there, okay?
Just as Jane says this, a terrifying sound echoes from upstairs.
...It sounds like the footsteps of a massive creature... With a closer listen, I can even make out a monstrous growling sound...
Ghosts are real?!
Jane! Did you hear that?!
Sounds like someone's walking around up there. Fascinating, this could be the clue that cracks the case!
About that... I think we could make it if we leave now!
Do you have a lead?
Hohoho... Unshaken in the face of paranormal events – just one more quality I look for in an assistant!
Listen closely – those footsteps sound hefty, but there's no variation in the weight or rhythm... almost like the sound is being made by something mechanical.
I'm more inclined to believe the noise is being produced by an object than by a living being... So, you can relax.
She then presses her ear against the wall and, closing her eyes, listens intently for a few seconds.
...I see, from over there?
Jane points at the wall. Following her finger, I see an opened valve.
Why's it all the way up there?! Didn't anyone give a second thought to maintaining this place?!
What do we do now...?
I should have brought a ladder.
This won't be easy, but you'll never be completely prepared for every situation. We'll just have to problem-solve with the tools we have.
Tools... tools... Hmm...
You can stare at me all you want, but I can't produce tools out of thin air...
Hohoho, I know what to do! You, hold me up so I can get a little higher!
What am I, a human ladder...?!
That's just part of team work! Ready, set, go!
...Try and hold me steady, would you? I don't exactly love heights...!
As instructed, I lift her up as high as I can. She's much lighter than I anticipated. She may have seemed a little scared, but she proceeds decisively.
Good...?
Hnngg... Almost... there!!
Got it!
Jane gives me a thumbs-up. She cautiously climbs back down, then straightens out her clothes.
Whew... That should do the trick! Can you hear anything now?
Huh? The footsteps... They've stopped?!
Was it an issue with the plumbing?
That's right. Sudden changes in water pressure in old, neglected pipes can produce the "water hammer" effect.
Basically, when water flowing through a pipe is suddenly shut off, the water's momentum triggers a pressure wave that rebounds and strikes the pipe repeatedly, sounding much like a hammer.

Since the pipes run through the mansion's floors and walls, the vibrations were amplified by the open spaces to the point that they sounded like a giant walking around upstairs. Meanwhile, that growling sound earlier was just air in the pipes.
That said... this suggests that a water source was deliberately turned on somewhere in the mansion. Our adversary could be right nearby, so we'd better tread carefully... Hm?
Is something wrong?
...Look at the wall next to the pipe. Do you see something stuck to it?
Huh? You're right, it looks like... a wet piece of paper?
Let me see...!
Jane...?
I think I remember you showing me this before...
...Yes, it's the manuscript that famous author left behind – the one who founded the Detective X Agency and wrote the bestseller, The Adventures of Jane Christie.
Jane's expression darkens for a moment. She once mentioned that her grandmother passed away before publishing the final novel in the series, leaving only a manuscript behind.

She was so excited when she showed it to me. She always wore her detective's gloves when taking out the manuscript, and handled it with the utmost care so as to perfectly preserve it... That manuscript is Jane's treasure.
Jane...
Could this all have been bait to lure us here?
Are they hoping this will make them go viral...?
Hmm... We'll need more clues before we can start theorizing.
Stay alert from here. Whatever they're plotting, we'll just have to be ready to react. Let's go check out the next room.
This room... smells a little different from the last one, doesn't it?
Indeed... There's a slight pungency in the air. Smells like turpentine.
It's the smell of the pigments used in fine oil paintings. I think... this room must have been a studio, or an exhibition room.

If I'm not mistaken, long-term exposure to turpentine can lead to chronic toxicity in painters... The sufferer would likely exhibit signs of mental instability, which could account for the rumors about the hauntings.
Shine that flashlight on the wall in the center of this room, would you?
(Do as she asks)
As I cast the beam of light over the wall, a towering oil portrait splays into view.
It's a painting of a woman, and the scary part is... two streams of red liquid are trickling from her eyes, like blood...
Not only that... in this eerie light and atmosphere, it looks like her eyes are locked onto me...!
Is this painting watching me?!
Hohoho, now it's getting interesting!
Um... I don't think I'm ready for this!
What sort of game are they playing this time?
Fascinating. Would you pass me the masks we prepared earlier?
Hmm... This color and consistency could only mean...
Jane extends a gloved finger and collects a bit of the "blood." Cautiously, she gives it a sniff.
Isn't that dangerous?!
Jane... are you okay?
Relax, dear assistant. This isn't real blood, it's artificial – it smells of honey, which must have been used as an additive to increase the fluid's viscosity.
The question is... how did they make it look like the painting was weeping blood as soon as we entered this room...?
Give me a hand, would you? I want to see the back of this painting.
On it!
Hey, Jane... Does the backing board look loose anywhere?
Excellent! Your observation skills have improved, dear assistant! Let's see what's behind this...
...As expected.
Let me guess, more of the manuscript?
...If the circumstances weren't so dire, I would commend your powers of deduction.
It's another photocopy, increasing the probability that the suspect is already in possession of the original manuscript.
Every move we've made... has been according to their plan.
It's no coincidence that the pages have appeared right after we've solved the puzzles.
...This isn't your run-of-the-mill criminal. We'll need to be at the top of our game from here on out.
I'll have your back!
I'll keep you safe!
Great...! I feel much better knowing you're at my side! Come on, we have a case to investigate!
Everything is starting to look the same in here...
Huh? At the end of the hall... Do you see someone?
Clear as day, on the wall at the end of the hallway... is a life-sized silhouette of a hanged person.
This slender specter even looks like it's swaying with a faint rhythm...
Right... Time to run the other way!
Tricks like that don't scare me!
Heh, you already have the cool-headedness of a bona fide assistant!
You're right, this is definitely another one of the suspect's tricks... and the reason...
Shine a light on the ceiling, would you?
(Do as she asks)
There's no rope...?
Nope. And if there's no rope, how could someone really be hanging there? If we look at the angle of the light...
Hold the flashlight there for me. I'll be right back.
Leave it to me!
Jane strides down the hallway, vanishing from view at the other end. Then comes a strange noise.
Jane!!
(Run after her)
I find Jane standing smugly with her hands on her hips – she's fine. Something before her, however, is lying in disarray...
It's the base of an antique music box. On top, wire has been tied haphazardly around paper scraps and twigs, twisting them into an eerie shape. Beside it is a broken mirror.
Hohoho... Sounds like you ran here. Were you that worried about me?
Isn't your safety my business as your assistant?
...Th-that's right! Why are you sounding so cool all of a sudden...?
Ahem! Look over here and I'll explain how it works!
The bundle of paper and twigs might not look like it has a discernible shape, but from a certain angle, the moonlight reflecting off the mirror casts a silhouette resembling a person onto the wall.
Throw in this music box's turning mechanism, and you have a hanging figure swaying in midair.
That's the truth behind what we saw before – it was nothing more than a simple projection, and I've already taken care of it!
Ugh...
Are you okay? You don't look so good...
...I have a bad feeling.
The noise in the pipes, the timed painting trick, using moonlight to cast an image...
Whoever's in this mansion, they aren't some wannabe ABC theft copycat. This person is well-versed in construction, physics, and even psychology.
You mean... "D" actually has the original manuscript...?!
And...
Calm down, Jane. "D" is just trying to get under your skin!
Don't let "D" get to you!
I know... and I AM calm! I just want to catch that charlatan and expose all their tricks right in their face!
I can't shake the feeling that something is off...
Like in a detective novel, some force seems to be practically drawing us closer and closer to the truth...
Look, over there! Is that a glimmer of light at the end of the hall?
I... think so?
Let's go check it out...!
As we approach the light source, a rare expression crosses Jane's face – one of panic.
Something's on fire... Is that the rest of the manuscript?!
Jane...! Wait a minute!
But Jane is already rushing over to the flaming pages. With each step she takes, a faint clicking sound echoes in the darkness.
Not good...!
Stop, it's too dangerous!!
(Grab Jane and yank her back)
As I pull Jane back, a plastic bucket plummets down from a high shelf up above and crashes to the floor, sending an echo throughout the mansion and spilling black paint all over the floor.
If I hadn't reacted when I did, that bucket would have landed right on Jane's head.
Hah... Hah...
Jane! Are you okay?!
Are you hurt?!
I-I'm fine...
Sorry...
I was so worried about the manuscript that I completely lost it for a moment there...
For all that I pride myself on being a great detective, I still fell for their mind game – and even put us in danger...
It's okay, I've still got your back.
You're only human.
Whew...
Huh, so that's what she was like...
But thanks to you... I've fully regained my composure.
If you look more closely... what's burning is just a pile of ordinary papers. I suspect that "D" used white phosphorus.
I see... Just how many tricks does "D" have up their sleeve?
So, while we may be a little worse for wear right now, I don't think this was a total loss.
At least... I think I'm beginning to understand the criminal's motive.

"D" is probably a hardcore fan of The Adventures of Jane Christie and resents that I solved the ABC theft case. So, they rigged up this horror house just to mock me and showcase their gift for criminal behavior.
And if that's the case, then "D" wouldn't pass up the opportunity to taunt me in the final trap. Come, help me inspect the scene.
The bottom of this bucket... seems to have writing on it.
...Honestly, they even applied a waterproof coating. You can see it if you look from a slightly different angle.
"When the arms of the giant fall and meet, twilight's final chapter will be complete."
...What an arrogant coward – you thought you could humiliate me, but instead you've just exposed yourself.
Exposed...?
Is there a clue here?
Remember our criminal profiling exercise from before?

The intimate knowledge of my past, the painstakingly accurate recreations of scenes from the novels, the compulsive tendencies evident in how the traps were set, along with this waterproof coating used to leave me a message I was bound to find...
Hohoho...! With these clues, I think I can already begin to deduce the criminal's motive and modus operandi!
Jane turns her head. The confusion and fear in her eyes have cleared, replaced by a radiance as brilliant as a star.
I'll be getting that manuscript, as well as my honor, back with my own two hands!
Come! The real showdown against "D"... begins now!
Sigh... Looks like converting my assistant to my brand of skepticism will be harder than I thought.
Fine, I guess we'll just call it a day!
This isn't a matter of beliefs! We could actually be in danger!
Hmm... You're right, we didn't come fully prepared for this. Let's regroup and make another attempt!
And so, we fled the spooky mansion.
Later, just when I was about to contact Jane to plan our return to the mansion, she called me on the phone first.
H-hey!! D-do you remember what the date was the day we went to the mansion?!
Of course. It was the 17th, if I'm not mistaken. Is everything okay?
W-well according to this news report, that mansion was demolished on the 15th!
Excuse me?!!!
Ah... Ahaha... It must have been a dream! Or maybe we just misremembered the date...!
That's the spirit! Now, give it your all!
Nice, I like your enthusiasm!
You smell that? It's musty, like rotting wood. Must be a leak in here somewhere.
"...Thud! ...Thud! ...Thud!"
This... is from my grandma's manuscript!
The ending to the series is there in my grandma's unpublished manuscript...
You know, she's the reason I decided to become a detective.
But that plumbing puzzle from earlier and the atmosphere in this mansion are a lot like scenes from Grandma's novels. Perhaps "D" has had their sights set on the manuscript for some time now...
So... I'm afraid we can't rule out the possibility that "D" really did get their hands on Grandma's manuscript. As for the staging of the scene and the underlying motive...
What we can say for certain, however, is that the suspect knows both Grandma's novels and me very well... You could almost say they're after me.
I see... It's a mechanism connecting the door to these blood bags behind the painting. As expected, another scene from Grandma's novels.
That's Grandma's handwriting, I'm certain of it...
Relax! Our adversary is recreating scenes from Grandma's books, so I already know the answer to the puzzle!
And... they're deeply familiar with my grandma's books, clearly – all of those mechanisms were just like ones that appeared in her novels...
And crucially, I know for a fact that this last trick is a scene straight out of her unpublished manuscript...!
How dare that lowlife use Grandma's precious manuscript... as a prop in such a stupid charade...! It's unforgivable!!
Thank you, {var:player_nickname}. If Grandma were here, she'd probably give me a good smack upside the head.
Think about it, only a die-hard fan would be so determined to recreate scenes from Grandma's novels. There's no way they would actually burn her original manuscript.
I... I'll get to the b-bottom of this...! My voice is only sh-shaking... because I'm c-cold...! Bring me a jacket! Quickly!

When we closed that valve earlier, the water level inside the pipe dropped, exposing the hidden white phosphorus to the air and causing it to oxidize and ignite... Then, the flames traveled up a connecting rope straight into the papers arranged in advance – all to create the illusion that the manuscript had been set ablaze.
The ABC thefts were a string of crimes in the city in which the perp stole a series of valuable items closely associated with the letters A, B, and C.
You might think that, as D follows C, the thief's next target would have something to do with the letter D. And from there, they would go on to E, then F, and all the way through the alphabet, right?

Ahem... It's okay... Grandma's manuscript should be locked away safely at the detective agency in a reinforced vault... This is only a copy... we can't jump to any conclusions until we check the original...
